meaning: At each observed cutoff, a supplied stable copy-law profile has a nonempty evidence cell, exact persistence predictions and an outcome-wise optimal bet irrespective of the supplied Scope ground. A shared-prefix open-future profile admits true/false next values, defeats exact prediction and every outcome-wise optimal action but retains a safe action; even a grounded scope can accompany this failure. Adding the stable-law restriction strictly narrows that cell and improves prediction. Reuses both Hume test certificates; no empirical or normative entitlement conclusion.
